You can do for  me i autorize to do dashboard at https://dashboard.render.com → service srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0 → check deploy logs for the update_failed error. The build succeeds but the service fails to start — this could be a startup crash, port binding issue, or memory limit. The Render API returned empty logs.

To unblock PR #51 merge: Go to GitHub → repo settings → branches → main → edit protection rule → temporarily uncheck "Enforce admins" → then I can merge PR #51 via the production API and restore protection.
